justification: Function acts as a simple dispatcher without risky memory operations or unchecked attacker inputs.
analysis: This function takes attacker-influenced inputs through skb (network packet data) and state (netfilter hook state). It processes packet information by calling nft_set_pktinfo and related functions, then passes the packet info to nft_do_chain. The function performs a simple switch on state->pf but doesn't validate or sanitize any attacker-controlled data before passing it to downstream functions. No memory allocation, deallocation, or complex indexing occurs in this function.
